categories.main_business_segments: FactSet operates through three main business segments based on geography: the Americas, EMEA (Europe, Middle East, and Africa), and Asia Pacific. Each segment delivers solutions across three workflow categories: Research & Advisory, Analytics & Trading, and Content & Technology Solutions (CTS). These segments reflect how the company manages its business and serves clients globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: FactSet's core technologies include an open and flexible digital platform that integrates expansive financial data, sophisticated analytics, and cloud-based solutions. The company leverages APIs, configurable desktop and mobile platforms, comprehensive data feeds, and cloud infrastructure to deliver its services. FactSet also utilizes proprietary and third-party data aggregation, advanced data management, and cognitive computing to support client workflows.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FactSet primarily serves investment professionals, including asset managers, bankers, wealth managers, asset owners, channel partners, hedge funds, corporate users, private equity, and venture capital professionals. Its solutions are used across the investment lifecycle, supporting both buy-side (83% of revenue) and sell-side (17%) clients in research, portfolio management, trading, risk management, and reporting.
categories.geographic_coverage: FactSet has a global presence with 39 offices in 20 countries, serving clients in the Americas, EMEA, and Asia Pacific. The Americas segment (mainly the U.S.) accounts for 64% of revenue, EMEA for 26%, and Asia Pacific for 10%. The company’s workforce is also globally distributed, with significant operations in India and the Philippines.
categories.supply_chain_position: FactSet operates as a downstream provider in the financial information supply chain, delivering data, analytics, and workflow solutions directly to end users in the investment community. It aggregates and refines data from upstream content suppliers and exchanges, then packages and distributes this information through its platforms and services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: FactSet’s strategic focus is on building the leading open content and analytics platform, expanding its digital platform and content refinery, and delivering cloud-based, personalized workflow solutions. The company invests heavily in R&D to enhance data depth, analytics, and technology, with emphasis on cloud migration, ESG data, private markets, and workflow automation. Partnerships and acquisitions, such as CUSIP Global Services, are used to accelerate growth and differentiation.
categories.revenue_model: FactSet generates the majority of its revenue through subscription-based models, providing access to its data, analytics, and workflow solutions on a recurring basis. Additional revenue streams include professional services, project-based consulting, and licensing of proprietary identifiers (e.g., CUSIP). The company’s revenue is highly predictable, with annual subscription value retention rates above 95%.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: FactSet’s main competitors are Bloomberg L.P., Refinitiv (LSEG), and S&P Global Market Intelligence, along with other data and analytics providers like BlackRock Solutions, Morningstar, and MSCI. FactSet positions itself as a comprehensive, open, and flexible platform with deep integration into client workflows, emphasizing breadth of data, analytics, and client service as key differentiators.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal 2022, FactSet reported revenues of $1.84 billion, up 15.9% year-over-year, with organic revenue growth of 9.8%. Operating income was $475 million, and net income was $397 million. The company has a strong growth trajectory, driven by both organic expansion and acquisitions, and maintains high client retention and recurring revenue visibility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FactSet’s value proposition centers on delivering an open, integrated, and highly configurable platform that connects reliable data, advanced analytics, and workflow tools for investment professionals. The company emphasizes its ability to provide comprehensive, multi-asset class solutions, deep sector and ESG data, and exceptional client service, making its products central to clients’ investment decision-making processes.
